messages:
rachel: Noticed recurring GPU stall waves in us-east1 this morning. Looks correlated with a handful of tenants on fractional-dedicated slices doing heavy KV+egress work. Latency SLOs for nearby tenants jump. Any quick isolation ideas? :frowning:

tom: can you paste the query and a sample tenant id?

rachel: sure. sample tenant: tenant-omega. promQL: 
```
sum(rate(kv_out_bytes{region=\"us-east1\"}[1m])) by (tenant)
```
plus gpu_runqueue_seconds and nvlink_retry_count spikes around the same time.

jia: ops-bot shows alert chain: us-east1_gpu_stall_wave firing -> grouped by slice. ops-bot:alert_id=usg-stall-2101

ops-bot: Alert us-east1_gpu_stall_wave started at 2024-07-03T09:12:11Z severity=warning affected_slices=3

will: short-term we can do: 1) soft-quarantine tenant -> limit egress burst 2) spin fractional slice off to a chilled host 3) reroute noisy KV requests to hosted fallback. Prefer eBPF shaping at the pod NIC for minimal infra churn.

rachel: agree. Also worried about cross-AZ egress cost if we fallback to hosted in another region. prefer same-az hosted first, then same-region.

tom: proposed detection rule (reduce false positives): 
```
WHEN kv_out_rate(tenant) > 200Mbps AND gpu_runqueue_seconds_p50 > 0.2s AND nvlink_retry_count > 0 FOR 90s
```

jia: implementation note: eBPF hook prototype exists as egress_police v0.2. Config example: 
```
program: egress_police v0.2
policy: soft_quarantine
params: burst_sec=20, rate_mbps=100, fallback=hosted-us-east1
emit_metric: tenant_reroute_count, rerouted_token_est
```

will: ops playbook draft: 
- canary 3% of fractional slices in us-east1 for 24h
- owners notified on first reroute, auto-ticket if >5 reroutes/hr
- revert if false positive within 5m
- collect rerouted_token_est + extra_egress_cost tag for billing

rachel: cost quick calc: tenant-omega had ~900k outbound bytes in 6m -> ~34k tokens -> ~+$0.09 if rerouted to hosted us-east at current pricing. But avoided stall minutes could save far more in GPU minutes.

tom: question: do we prefer eviction of KV cache vs immediate reroute? eviction buys short breathing room but may increase downstream KV hits. leaning toward soft-shape -> eviction -> reroute as last resort.

jia: agree. sequence: mark tenant soft-fenced -> trigger async KV-evict request -> monitor runqueue. If still high after 30s, reroute.

will: I'll own the playbook + canary rollout. Jia, can you push eBPF config to staging? Tom, can you add detection rule to alert manager? Rachel, add sample token cost calc to the incident doc?

rachel: on it. tagging: add billing:cost_center=egress-mitigation when reroute happens.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled egress_police v0.2 to staging 1725072000 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

will: final ask: metric names please: tenant_reroute_count, rerouted_token_est, slice_soft_quarantine_active. We want Optimize team to run a cost/regression check after 48h.

rachel: adding those metrics now. canary starts tomorrow 03:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
